construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch in the isolated build directory

shared_schema.input: Strict object containing schema_version, synthetic=true, catalog JSON feed, customer profile/explicit consent, order or basket with shown price and stock, clickstream event-log array, ticket, and routing config.
shared_schema.catalog: Unique invented SKU, name, nonnegative two-decimal price string, integer stock; currency USD/EUR/GBP.
shared_schema.clickstream: Strictly increasing integer sequence, matching customer_id, known SKU, event view/add_to_basket/remove_from_basket.
shared_schema.output: schema_version, synthetic, status, ticket_id, customer_id, order_id, category, priority, route(team/owner), reason, personalization(applied/recent_skus), canonical catalog products, empty reviews and endorsements.
shared_schema.error: One JSON object with schema_version, status=error and error text; exit 2.
shared_schema.validation: validate() is shared by input and successful output; missing/extra fields, invalid relationships and retail constraint violations are rejected.

cross_stage_handoffs: Single triage stage: validated retail envelope -> configured categorization -> urgency override -> accountable team/owner -> output validation.

behavior.categorization: First ordered rule with a case-insensitive substring keyword match in subject/body wins; otherwise configured fallback.
behavior.priority: Configured category priority, overridden to urgent for any configured urgent substring.
behavior.routing: Every category requires a named team and accountable owner.
behavior.personalization: Only explicitly requested personalization uses clickstream SKUs; both GDPR and CCPA consent booleans must be true before using it.
behavior.catalog_integrity: Shown order/basket prices and stocks must equal the input catalog snapshot. Output products are copied from that snapshot.
behavior.reviews: Endorsement requests rejected; no review/endorsement generation or freeform model text is supported.
behavior.optional_callable: Python API triage(data, classifier=callable) accepts a local injected callable receiving only ticket subject/body and returning exactly one configured category; invalid returns or exceptions become validation errors.
behavior.synthetic_data: All products, shopper personas, identities and orders are fictitious and explicitly labeled synthetic.

scope.limitations: Demonstrative consent rules are not legal advice. Catalog is authoritative for this one request, not a live inventory source. Historical orders use snapshot prices. Keyword matching is substring-based, not semantic. Ticket prose is untrusted text used for category matching, never published as endorsements. Quantities do not reserve or decrement stock.

test_outcomes.cli: passed: one JSON object, status=ok, category=delivery, priority=high
coverage: CLI success, malformed JSON, missing file and argument errors
